name: Fat Cat Holdings
tagline: You don't own the cat. You work for him.
description: Fat Cat Holdings is run by one very large cat. He is not fat, he is accumulating. Read the employment agreement, sign it and report for duty. $FCH — a community memecoin on Solana.

hero.text: This agreement is made between the Management (one very large cat) and the Staff (you). The Management has reviewed it. The Management has gone back to sleep.

about.title: The Parties
text: The Management is a cat. He is the chairman, the board of directors and the only one who eats first.
He is not fat. He is accumulating. The accumulation phase has [[no end date]].
The Staff is you. You do not own the cat. You work for him.
Working hours: whenever the bowl is empty. ~~Overtime is paid.~~ {{No.}}
The Management may sit on any document, keyboard or employee [[that is warm]].

feed.title: Lunch of the Management

lines.hint: Move the Boss with your mouse, finger or arrow keys. Catch the food. Dodge the cucumber and the alarm clock.
lines.over: Lunch is over. The Boss accumulated {score} kg.

feed.shareText: My Boss accumulated {score} kg at lunch. He's not fat. He's accumulating. ${ticker}

boss.dismiss: Tap to send the Management away

howToBuy.title: Get a wallet
howToBuy.text: Install Phantom or Solflare from the official website or app store.

howToBuy.title: Get some SOL
howToBuy.text: Buy SOL on an exchange and send it to your wallet.

howToBuy.title: Open pump.fun
howToBuy.text: Connect your wallet and paste the $FCH contract address.

howToBuy.title: Swap for $FCH
howToBuy.text: Choose the amount and confirm the swap. Then report to the Management.

disclaimer: $FCH is a memecoin with no intrinsic value or expectation of financial return. It is not an investment. Nothing on this site is financial advice. Crypto is risky — never spend more than you can afford to lose. The employment agreement is a joke: nobody is hired and nobody is paid.

paper.finePrint: By reading this far you have already agreed. The Management may knock this agreement off the table at any time, for any reason, while maintaining eye contact. Complaints are accepted in writing and used as bedding.
